source: gpuwm-hex full-field history converted by rw_mpas_convert onto a regular lat/lon window; moving segments use one explicit latlon:S,N,W,E,DEG grid and each segment own mesh/init
time_policy: decoded at every valid time; terrain must remain identical on identical coordinates, including remeshed segments; --terrain-authority binds HGT from one fixed geographic frame, retaining the original atmospheric columns and absolute heights
member_policy: one hex run per input set; an ensemble member is its own run and its own frame set
vertical_policy: 55 MPAS model levels: full pressure in PB (P is zero), heights from the init zgrid in PHB (g = 9.80665) averaged to mass levels, theta from T + 300 K, temperature from theta with MPAS's own kappa (R/cp = 2/7) and p0 = 1e5 Pa
humidity_policy: QVAPOR and Q2 are dry-air mixing ratios; specific humidity is r / (1 + r), which initialization inverts exactly; condensate mixing ratios are carried as the run wrote them
wind_policy: RADAR_U_EARTH / RADAR_V_EARTH: earth-relative winds on the mass grid, the converter's full-field-set pair (no restaggering)
surface_policy: hex carries no ocean model: open-water skin temperature TSK is the SST the run was initialised with and is held, so SST is taken from TSK (water-skin-is-sst). Sea ice (SEAICE = xice) and snow (SNOW, SNOWH) are the land surface's own state from the history. Noah's four layers 0-10-40-100-200 cm map one to one.
input_identity: dynamic file paths and SHA-256 values are owned by the mapped input manifest
vertical_velocity_policy: W is interface vertical velocity in m s-1; mass_from_interfaces averages adjacent signed interfaces, prep interpolates to target mass levels then reconstructs interfaces with zero model-top/surface conditions. Both initial state and later boundary frames carry W. This remap is not bitwise checkpoint continuation.
number_moment_policy: QNCLOUD/QNICE/QNRAIN/QNSNOW/QNGRAUPEL/QNHAIL are optional published number mixing ratios (kg-1). Absence remains absence, not a fabricated zero analysis; active target scalar-package membership determines which are installed. A changed inventory between moving-segment frames is rejected by compose-source.
sgs_tke_policy: SGS TKE is not carried by this mapping. The proposed km_opt=3 diagnostic Smagorinsky LES closure has no prognostic SGS TKE state; km_opt=2 or another prognostic TKE closure needs an independently declared source field/initialization policy before claiming continuity.
